source.name: Cyclingnews: MAAP adds flames to signature Aurora purple for Jayco AlUla and Liv AlUla Jayco's new kit design for 2026
source.quote: Jayco AlUla and Liv AlUla Jayco have revealed their new MAAP kit design for the 2026 season
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention. MAAP's replica product page (https://maap.cc/products/womens-greenedge-26-pro-air-jersey-3-0-electric-purple) shows the MAAP repeat logo on the upper right chest and large across the upper back; the replica shorts (https://maap.cc/products/womens-worldtour-26-team-bib-evo-odyssey-white) show the MAAP repeat on both hips and on the straps.

summary: 2026 UCI Women's WorldTeam kit by MAAP, launched 6 January 2026 (Aurora purple with a flame motif; Cyclingnews). Liv fills the chest as the lead title sponsor, with Jayco above and the AlUla wordmark (with Arabic calligraphy) below; Jayco runs down the front of both sleeves, CADEX sits on the left shoulder top and the back-facing side of the sleeves, letsgo on the right shoulder top (and small marks below the back collar and on the torso side), the MAAP repeat and the GreenEDGE team logo on the upper chest. The back carries MAAP large, AlUla vertically, and small letsgo/MAAP marks; the jersey's side panels carry Liv (right) and AlUla (left). Shorts: AlUla large on the thighs and across the back of the waist, Liv on the right thigh, MAAP repeat on the hips and straps, and a small GreenEDGE logo on the lower leg. Marked complete: MAAP's front and back replica flat-lays and model photos show every panel of jersey and shorts. The 'UCI Women's WorldTeam' mark is an award badge and the '#ExperienceAlUla' tagline on the sleeve is AlUla's own slogan; GreenEDGE is the team operator, so none has a sponsor record. A separate white-and-green 'Swap-Out' kit worn at the 2026 Tour de France Femmes carries the same sponsors (per The Inner Ring's race photo).
